tool_args.rationale: The barrier-activation, base-field, and sink-gradient signatures align with the supplied four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon law. Across the five observations, sink gradient varies substantially and u_now spans a useful range, giving leverage on inhibition and the square-root branch term without another paid probe. Fit all four parameters numerically.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient span is broad (0.25 to 2.25), so the stated narrow-span trigger is absent; the available varied gradients already identify inhibition and branch contribution.
These use a saturating Michaelis base without barrier activation; the pilot signature explicitly reports barrier-activation onset, favoring the matching barrier-modulated flux law.
The rows are single-horizon scalar observations with changing u_now and s_grad, and the barrier signature is direct; no trajectory evidence motivates the higher-cost coupled-memory model.
All five observations have the same H, while the signatures point to barrier and sink effects rather than a horizon reversal.
